notes:
Overview: Mid-market SaaS (Sales engagement) looking for an outbound SDR chat agent that can do live streaming convos with tool calls into Salesforce and Calendar. Primary ask: hosted API to prove latency/UX; plan to move to Dedicated for cost predictability and isolation if POC meets SLAs.

Important requirements / quotes: 
- 'Need streaming like a video call — near-real-time token delivery so reps don't feel a lag' (Head of Product).
- Tool calling must be reliable: create/update SFDC lead, send templated outbound email, and create calendar invite without manual confirm. Action success rate target >= 98% in POC.
- Latency SLO: target p95 end-to-end chunk delivery <250ms; p99 <450ms. Also measuring cold-start for tool calls (auth handshake) <300ms target.
- Concurrency: 120 SDR seats, expected 40-60 concurrent streaming sessions during peak; avg tokens/sec per session low but bursts common during heavy cadences.
- Cost sensitivity: medium-high. Want to understand unit token pricing vs dedicated pool cost; interested in Optimize recommendations (batching + KV cache) to reduce per-token spend.
- Model preference: open-models are fine if Redwood verifies perf; willing to consider Redwood-curated variants. Fallback policy desired: smaller model for transient congestion with explainability.

POC notes: 
- 2-week perf POC scoped: 1) streaming latency baseline, 2) tool-calling reliability (Salesforce, Gmail send, Calendar invite), 3) end-to-end agent UX (stream + action).
- Early results (3/05): streaming chunk p95 ~220-280ms depending on seq len and batching config; p99 spikes to ~480ms in one test. SE suggested prefix caching + smaller batch window to stabilize p99.
- SE Jordan to run a focused test with continuous batching disabled and smaller kernel selection to see p99 improvements.

Security & compliance: 
- Asked for SOC2 Type II attestation (submitted). SSO/SAML required (IdP: Okta). Audit logs must be retained 13 months per legal. KMS integration for key wrapping preferred. Data residency: US only for POC.

Commercial: 
- Interested in 6mo reserved commit if POC meets latency SLOs and action reliability. Initial ARR target $60k-$120k. Need clear pricing for burst capacity and dedicated pool + overage rules.

Open items / next actions: 
- SE to run optimized perf run w/ recommended kernel settings and report p95/p99 by 2026-03-14 (Jordan).
- Finance follow-up to send counter-proposal for 6mo reserved by 2026-03-18 (AE Diego).
- Legal to confirm audit log retention and KMS integration feasibility (ticket RDW-4389).
